name: Over the shoulder
description: Two stat cards slide out from behind the speaker's head and their numbers count up. The footage stays full-bleed: no pull back, no zoom, only a light vignette.
when: When you name two proof numbers in one breath: views and followers, before and after.
needs: two labels with a number each
an optional short change tag for each
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in step 2)
